fact: From the EnDoS/DHIS2 warehouse, completeness of health facilities' monthly activity reports across the 15 health districts of the Centre-Est and Hauts-Bassins regions was above 91% in all districts but one in 2016 and 2018 and fell in 2019 to between 49% and 97.5%, a year of health workers' strikes; the figures are completeness of reports transmitted by districts, not a count of clinics keying their own.
title: Stakeholder's perception of the health information system performance in Burkina Faso
